ideas.pitch: An automated code and proposal compliance checker specifically tuned for Indian student hackathon submission formats, using graph intelligence and fine-tuned LightGBM models to predict judging success based on past winning patterns.
ideas.title: RealmSecure
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Best Build track by providing an intensely practical tool that hackathon organizers and participants can immediately appreciate and utilize.

ideas.pitch: A real-time geospatial asset and resource monitoring dashboard built for Indian college campuses to track energy consumption and waste management compliance using satellite data integration.
ideas.title: CampusPulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the Realm Champion track by offering clear, measurable environmental impact that appeals to academic administrators and judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered institutional mess and cafeteria nutrition planner designed for college hostels in India, providing personalized macro tracking and local ingredient optimization.
ideas.title: NutriCampus
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds directly on proven wellness and nutrition hackathon success formulas while targeting a pain point experienced by every student living in a hostel.
